svg.title: Episteme — C4 component view of the API
svg.desc: C4 component diagram of the Episteme API: the web app posts a question to the router and scope guard; regular questions go to the Graph-RAG retriever, which reads the FAISS index and kNN graph, and chapter requests go to chapter mode, which reads the pages from object storage; the generator (Qwen2.5-1.5B) writes a cited answer, the analogy and diagram step adds a figure built from relations found in the sources, and the sentence verifier checks every sentence with the multilingual-e5 embedder before the answer returns.
